After locking 61 units the clerk publishes pit P=H(pubkey||bay||turn) mod the yard roster; at second (hash mod 27)+9 the key drops a 38 cm velvet damper on a 1.9 mm copper rail so mic M records the first echo in that hash's 27 ms bin. A timing miss over 6 ms, an off-bin echo, or a reused bay-id burns 24 units and sidelines the key 13 epochs; a cloned waveform or second fault empties the stake for 19 epochs.
